notes: Balanced and conservative are constrained equal-weight reference allocations, not return forecasts.
The minimum-variance portfolio is optimized only for historical covariance under the balanced profile's group and subgroup caps.
Residual allocation is represented as cash with a zero daily return; no cash amount is inferred for the actual holdings.
Walk-forward evaluation trains only on observations strictly before each out-of-sample block; SKHY's short ADR history can leave very few test observations.
No transaction costs, taxes, liquidity, lot sizes, market impact, or broker execution are included in these allocation comparisons.
